name: Wall Sit
summary: An isometric leg hold against a wall that builds muscular endurance in the thighs without equipment.
setup: Stand with your back flat against a wall and feet about shoulder width apart.
Walk your feet forward about two feet from the wall.
Slide your back down the wall.
execution: Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor, or higher if that is too hard.
Keep your knees above your ankles and your back flat on the wall.
Rest your hands on your thighs or hold them in front, not on your knees.
Breathe steadily and hold for the time, then slide up the wall.
mistakes: Knees in front of the toes: walk the feet farther from the wall.
Sitting too high or too low to hold: pick a depth you can hold with good form.
Pushing with the hands on the knees: rest hands on thighs or in front of you.
Holding your breath: breathe slowly throughout.
